name: Òdena (Spain)
description: Blue field strewn with white crosses, over all a yellow bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: The flag was approved on 15 April 1993 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1738 of 28 April 1993; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, strewn with white crosses of arms 1/31 of the height and 5/21 long, separated by 3/21, with a yellow bend 1/15 of the diagonal over all.

features.role: semy of crosses with arms 1/31 of the height
bend 1/15 of the diagonal in width
